answer.summary: A restored End city of ten buildings laid in a ring round a central terrace, near your founding stone. The grand spire keep and two spire towers take the high ground. The three dwellings, gathering hall, vault, workshop and ship dock sit round the terrace, with the dock at the edge. The land is blended into the pads, and the style is purpur and end stone, to be set once the style bible exists. Dwellings are joined by streets, not bridges.
